versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

Initial release of the Slackbot skill with managed OAuth and full-featured Slack workspace automation.

- Integrates with Slack via managed OAuth, no API keys required.
- Supports messaging (send, update, delete, schedule), channel management, user and group operations.
- Offers file operations: upload, download, sharing, deletion, commenting.
- Includes automation for reminders, reactions, pins, and Slack canvases.
- Read, write, and destructive operations are clearly labeled for safety.
- Comprehensive command reference and setup instructions provided.
